tasks.keeps: Completions philosophy, definitions and certificate flow

agents.does: Checks the draft plan against owner completions requirements and contract definitions of MC, RFSU and handover

tasks.keeps: System definition and start-up order

agents.does: Lists equipment, units and utility streams from PFDs and utility diagrams as input to system definition

tasks.keeps: Boundary and isolation point decisions

agents.does: Extracts tags, valves and isolation points from P&IDs and single-lines along the marked boundaries
Checks every P&ID tag falls in exactly one subsystem and lists gaps and overlaps

tasks.keeps: Commissioning logic and committed turnover dates

agents.does: Drafts the required turnover date table per subsystem and flags clashes with the construction path

tasks.keeps: Check sheet content and ITR scheme approval

agents.does: Drafts the ITR matrix mapping A, B and C check sheets to discipline tag types
Cites owner and discipline inspection requirements by tag type for each check sheet

tasks.keeps: Subsystem assignment of ambiguous tags and register acceptance

agents.does: Builds the tag-to-subsystem register from line, equipment, instrument and cable lists against marked boundaries
Compares register tags against SPID, SI and SPEL and lists missing or duplicate tags

tasks.keeps: Approval of the Smart Completions load

agents.does: Prepares the load sheet and generates ITRs per tag from the matrix; flags tags with no matrix match

tasks.keeps: Procedure method, limits and safety precautions

agents.does: Pulls vendor flushing, cleaning, drying and preservation requirements from vendor manuals into a requirement table
Answers spec requirements for flushing velocity, leak test media and inerting criteria with citations

tasks.keeps: Test method, acceptance criteria and procedure approval

agents.does: Checks procedure test steps cover every C&E line and SIF in the SRS and lists omissions
Extracts vendor run-in and function test requirements from vendor manuals into a test requirement table

tasks.keeps: Final consumables list and need dates by system

agents.does: Pulls lubricant, chemical, catalyst, filter and first-fill quantities from vendor data and lists them by system

tasks.keeps: Vendor support scope, timing and call-off

agents.does: Extracts vendor representative scope and man-day allowances from purchase orders per package
Requests and tracks vendor representative mobilisation dates against the commissioning schedule

tasks.keeps: Temporary facilities design and flushing arrangements

agents.does: Drafts temporary spool, blind and strainer quantity lists from flushing circuits and isometric data

tasks.keeps: MC forecast validation and recovery actions

agents.does: Tracks test pack prepared, tested and reinstated status per subsystem and forecasts MC dates

tasks.keeps: Punch categorisation and clearance acceptance

agents.does: Drafts punch entries from walkdown notes with subsystem, category and action-by party; summarises open items
Reminds action-by parties of open punch items ahead of subsystem need dates

tasks.keeps: Acceptance and custody transfer of the subsystem

agents.does: Checks turnover packages for complete A-ITRs, cleared A punch, test records and dossier before acceptance

tasks.keeps: Executing pre-commissioning tests and signing B-ITRs

agents.does: Checks recorded B-ITRs for missing values, out-of-tolerance results and missing vendor sign-offs

tasks.keeps: Performing loop checks and accepting loops

agents.does: Compares loop check records against SI loop data and the DCS/SIS I/O list and lists mismatches
Reports loop check status and open defects by subsystem against the commissioning schedule

tasks.keeps: Test execution, witnessing and SIF acceptance

agents.does: Checks recorded results against every C&E line and SRS requirement and lists untested or failed items

tasks.keeps: Energisation permit, switching and authorisation

agents.does: Lists missing prerequisite records per feeder: protection test results, ITRs and permit references

tasks.keeps: Commissioning execution, RFSU decision and certificate signature

agents.does: Checks C-ITRs, test results and start-up punch per system and lists open RFSU items
Checks PSSR and safety study actions due before start-up have close-out evidence and lists gaps

tasks.keeps: Problem diagnosis and any design modification decision

agents.does: Answers commissioning queries already covered by design records with citations; drafts and routes the rest

tasks.keeps: Dossier completeness approval and sign-off

agents.does: Assembles system dossiers from certificates, ITRs, test records, punch and vendor data and lists gaps
Checks as-built and vendor document revisions in the dossier against Document Locator status

tasks.keeps: Handover certificate, agreed punch exceptions and signatures

agents.does: Records handover meetings, agreed punch exceptions and owner actions and tracks them to closure

tasks.keeps: Validation and issue of the progress report

agents.does: Compiles ITR, punch and certificate counts by system from Smart Completions and drafts the report narrative

tasks.keeps: Test conduct, data correction and guarantee conclusions

agents.does: Extracts guarantee values and test conditions from vendor and licensor data into the comparison table
